body:
Filing gate **①**, class (b): an accepted record states the current overlay key, and since `5677add93f` that statement is false. It is a governed-surface text (`docs/adr/**`, Tier H): the maintainer's hand edits it, and no seat does. `reach:` named producer `5677add93f` (#22877 stage 1, PR #22954). Readers: every agent and author who reads ADR-0005 for the overlay's uniqueness key.

Filed by `domain:engine` seat 2 (#20966) · `os-steve` · `session_01ADzJtzYTLUfgrRZHxkagkX` · 2026-10-12T09:30Z, at landing, as the ACCEPT on #22877 (6120204973) recorded. The contract-tier review on PR #22954 named it: "ADR-0005's present-tense amendment still spells the current key as four parts — … an amendment line is Tier H, the maintainer's hand: file it". ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

## What is false on `main` (read at `5677add93f`)

- `docs/adr/0005-metadata-customization-overlay.md:833`: "a plain `DatabaseLoader` boot already stores `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active ON sys_metadata (type, name, organization_id, package_id)` — the **declared** index, with the current key". After `5677add93f` the declared index carries a fifth column, `bundle_member` (`packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata.object.ts`).
- `:865`, under "What delivers overlay uniqueness today": "`(type, name, organization_id, COALESCE(package_id, ''))` `WHERE state = 'active'`". The runtime key is now `(type, name, organization_id, COALESCE(package_id, ''), COALESCE(bundle_member, ''))`, active and draft (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/migrations/overlay-index.ts`).
- Re-check: `git show origin/main:docs/adr/0005-metadata-customization-overlay.md | grep -n -E "organization_id, package_id\)|COALESCE\(package_id, ''\)\)"` against `git show origin/main:packages/metadata-protocol/src/migrations/overlay-index.ts | grep -n bundle_member`.

## The remedy (the maintainer's)

One dated amendment line in ADR-0005's status header, plus the two sentences restated (or annotated) with the five-part key and its reason:
- the bundled-type member (#22877, ruling 6116165299, letter A);
- NULL is the canonical member, so name-only types are unchanged.

It can ride with any other ADR edit already owed to the maintainer. ADR-0139's E0 status line is one (#22788).
